published_prior_art.cite: LallyKazemiPaoletti2026RobustCounterfactualMDP: exact no-assumption one-step posterior bounds and compatible response-law gluing, but not the trajectory-Shapley shared-object projection.
ZhangTianBareinboim2022PartialCounterfactual: generic canonical-SCM polynomial programs for counterfactual bounds, not the attained shared posterior-row Shapley interval.

WitterEtAl2026ExactlyDoShapley: exact do-Shapley compression through graph-induced irreducible classes; the beta-integral identity is standard and the Markov specialization is distinct but modest alone.
LiuIhler2013MarginalMAP: generic sum-before-max mixed inference supplies the surrounding nonnegative-factor framework; this signed-objective lift is a task-specific reduction.

LiuIhler2013MarginalMAP and ChoiFriedmanVanDenBroeck2022MarginalMAP address generic marginal-MAP elimination and circuit transformations, not a circuit whose row selectors represent one posterior SCM shared across every trajectory-Shapley coalition.

LeePleckoBareinboim2026ImprovingCausalExplanations is disclosed as non-archival technical-report WIP with unavailable theorem text; no inspected published source gives this open nondegenerate separation between one-SCM and coalitionwise optimization.

LallyKazemiPaoletti2026RobustCounterfactualMDP explicitly leaves transition-probability uncertainty as future work; KaidoMolinariStoye2019CalibratedProjection is generic projection inference rather than this posterior-row fiber.

BennettKallusOprescuSunWang2024RobustOPE studies sharp robust policy-value endpoints under a marginal sensitivity model, not trajectory-conditioned shared-SCM Shapley endpoint stability with a factual-cell denominator.
LiLeeBareinboim2026CounterfactualShapley: Equation 7 and Assumption 3.3 select reuse on the factual row and resampling from the Markov transition law off it.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v1, 6 February 2026; ICML 2026 paper version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper exactly computes do-Shapley values in time linear in the number of irreducible intervention classes and studies singleton-query identifiability; it does not contain posterior conditioning or shared latent endpoint optimization.
The paper reduces finite discrete counterfactual bounding to tight canonical-SCM polynomial programs and states that the general optimization is computationally expensive.

The paper gives sharp policy-value endpoints under a multiplicative transition sensitivity model together with efficient asymptotically normal estimation; its estimand and ambiguity model differ from the proposed conditional Shapley interval.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a worked H=3 circuit instance that explicitly lists the shared row selectors, a legal elimination order, its constrained width, and recovered endpoint sampler; this will turn the compiler handle into a directly auditable construction.

State a formal non-subsumption corollary against the Lally no-assumption row program: exhibit a multi-coalition objective for which independently sharp rowwise extrema cannot be jointly realized, then connect it directly to the open-gap theorem.

Specify one concrete simultaneous multinomial polytope and give an explicit shrinking-radius corollary under p_t at least κ, separating finite-sample coverage from the endpoint-consistency consequence.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the compiler as the central solve target; retain the already-known counterfactual-independence reduction only as a sanity check.
